verdict.rationale: BAMF is a government migration and refugee information and service portal, and such a portal could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or chatbot, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows the product can be operated through natural-language commands. The multilingual service teams [bamf-docs-3] are human advisors, not a natural-language interface, and BAMF-NAvI [bamf-docs-2] is described only as a guide to local integration offers.
